items.title: [Steam论坛] I enjoy the story, but I do wish this wasn't a gacha.
items.summary: New player here, clocked in almost 14 hours so far, finished chapter 1 with a team of Lv.3s and chapter 2 with a team of Lv.10s, I was actually struggling a fair bit in chapter 2 cause the recommended level was steadily ramping due to me not touching the gacha part of the game, but that doesn't mean I'm a stranger to it, it's just that while I enjoy the story I would prefer it to not have the usual stuff (Farm ascension mats, farm skill mats, farm equipment RNG substats and stats, farm the card
